Can’t meditate? BEAT + BREATH™ counts you back to calm.

Made by a Registered Psychotherapist and a Grammy nominated composer, for everyone whose mind won’t sit still for meditation.

Put on your headphones, press play and just breathe. BEAT + BREATH™ gives you a steady beat, a voice that counts out loud for you, and five breaths that train you to breathe 4 to 10 breaths a minute. Train three minutes a day, like an athlete, and calm becomes encoded in your muscle memory.

You sat down, closed your eyes, and your to-do list got even louder. That doesn’t mean calm isn’t for you. We know silence is the hardest place to learn it, so we just skipped it. With BEAT + BREATH™, a steady beat gives your body a rhythm and a voice counting out loud gives your mind its only job: to follow. Your breath slows down without you forcing it. No cheesy voice telling you to calm down or just relax. Just a steady, faithful presence to guide you, breath by breath.

Think of us as holding your hand through your breathing practice, because let’s face it, sometimes you need it.

5 breaths for every mood and age, 3 levels to grow into.

Forty-five tracks in all: fifteen in each level, the five breaths at three counts. Each breath has its own pattern of inhaling, pausing and exhaling, set to its own track, from 4 seconds on the inhale all the way up to 12 seconds on the inhale and exhale. Counts shown at Level 1. Suitable for all ages and abilities: anyone who can follow a beat can follow BEAT + BREATH™, from five year olds to grandparents.

  • Basic Breath

    Inhale 4, exhale 4

    Trains your default breath to be slower and steadier all day long.

  • Bridge Breath

    Inhale 4, pause 4, exhale 4

    For calming emotions and building lung capacity.

  • Box Breath

    Inhale 4, pause 4, exhale 4, pause 4

    A balanced, grounding breath to reset under pressure.

  • Calm Breath

    Inhale 4, exhale 6

    Eases tension before bed or after a stressful stretch.

  • Super Calm Breath

    Inhale 4, exhale 4, pause 8

    For those “about to scream or cry” moments.

calm isn’t something you’re born with. it’s something you practice.

Train calm like an athlete.

Athletes don’t wait for game day to practice. They train a little bit every day. BEAT + BREATH™ works the same way: three minutes a day, on the beat and on the count, until slow breathing is already in your muscle memory when stress hits.

  1. Days 1 to 7

    Warm up

    Start with the guided 7-day intro and the 3 minute tracks. Breathe low into your belly and let the count set the pace.

  2. Every day

    Train

    Three minutes on the beat. Your everyday breath gets slower and steadier, one session at a time.

  3. When it feels easy

    Level up

    Move from Monkey Mind to Apprentice to Almost Enlightened, adding one second at a time. No straining, ever.

  4. 7, 14 and 28 days

    Build the streak

    The challenges keep you showing up, and the Breathing Room gives you a live training partner every weekday morning.

  5. Game day

    Calm on command

    When stress hits, you don’t have to think about it. Your body already knows how to count its way back to calm.

Questions people ask before they press play.

Anything else? Write to breathe@peopleoftheprana.com, or bring it to the monthly open call.

Is BEAT + BREATH™ suitable for beginners?

Yes. It was made for people who struggle with meditation or want an easier way to fit the practice into daily life. The beginner tracks are only 3 minutes long, so you can pair them with something you already do, like brushing your teeth, washing the dishes or walking the dog. You can even practice while scrolling on your phone.

I already have a breathwork practice. Is this for me?

Yes. The three levels let you match the practice to your own breath rhythm and keep progressing, and the five breaths give you plenty of variety. The rhythm keeps you steady and consistent, and stops you from cheating.

What’s the difference between the free app and BEAT + BREATH™?

The free app is where you start: a short belly breathing video, then Basic and Calm Breath, with the next breath opening after three minutes of practice on three days. BEAT + BREATH™ is the whole practice: all five breaths at every length, the manual, the challenges, the live Breathing Room and the community.

How often should I practice?

Ideally once a day, though even a few times a week helps shift your nervous system. During a stressful stretch, plug in and press play more often: you change your habitual stress pattern by changing your breath pattern.

How do I know where to begin?

Start with the 7-day intro and the 3 minute tracks, and practice at the timing that feels most comfortable. There should be no straining, no pushing and no feeling out of breath. Breathing is not a competition. Work your way up to longer, deeper breaths one second at a time.

Is there a special way to breathe?

Every BEAT + BREATH™ practice uses abdominal breathing: your belly expands as you inhale and draws back as you exhale. The 7-day intro and the free app both start there, because it’s the foundation of everything else.

Do I have to join the Breathing Room live?

No. The tracks work on their own, any time of day. The Breathing Room is there for the mornings you want company: 15 minutes of live practice, weekdays from 7:00 to 7:15 a.m. Eastern. It isn’t recorded, because every practice we do together is already in your tracks.

What happens to the Breathing Room after my first year of lifetime?

The tracks, the manual and the challenges stay yours for life. The Breathing Room is included for your first year. After that, you can keep coming to the live mornings for $20 a month or $90 a year, or carry on with the tracks on your own.

Who can practice BEAT + BREATH™?

Anyone. Literally. Practice with your young kids, your teenagers, your elderly parents, your friends, your co-workers, and even your enemies. Adjust the level so everyone breathing with you can keep up. Remember, those who breathe together, stay together.

What if breathing exercises make me anxious?

Start sitting or lying down. Once a breath feels easy, take it with you on a walk or while you wash the dishes, but never practice while driving. If you feel more anxious, stop and return to your natural breath. It probably means that changing your rhythm to a rhythm of calm might feel threatening at the moment, and that’s okay. Reach out to us, and consider taking Begin with Breath or the Nervous System First Aid Kit. Breathing is for you, but everybody needs to go at their own pace.

Is this therapy?

No. BEAT + BREATH™ is breath education. It was created by a Registered Psychotherapist, but it isn’t psychotherapy or medical advice, and it doesn’t replace care from your health care provider. If you’re already in treatment, it can sit alongside it.

Is BEAT + BREATH™ refundable?

Because BEAT + BREATH™ is a digital product, purchases aren’t refundable. That’s why you can try it free in the app first, or start with the monthly plan and cancel anytime. We want to help you learn to breathe, so send us your questions or bring them to the monthly open call.

Can you tell me about the certification?

Yes. The certification takes you deeper into the method so you can teach it to clients, offer it at your yoga studio or clinic, or share it with your team. Find out more about the certification.
